title: McDonald's Spectral Knight
description: A woman in ornate green and gold medieval armor with pink hair crouches beside a black wolf with glowing yellow eyes riding a green horse in decorative McDonald's-themed barding. The stone dungeon is filled with purple magical swirls, floating McDonald's food, white ghosts, and a glowing green portal in a barred window.
prompt: A dramatic fantasy scene set in a stone dungeon with barred windows showing a night sky. A woman in ornate green and gold armor with pink hair and bloody hands crouches in fear. Beside her stands a large black wolf with glowing yellow eyes riding atop a bright green horse wearing decorative McDonald's patterned barding. Swirling purple magical vortexes, floating hamburgers, french fries, and white translucent ghosts fill the air. Red blood splatters are visible. Mystical green portal glows in the background.
